frozen_identity.scope: ASML-inspired NL_ocean announced delays; known committed orders

limitations: The model alias and request configuration are fixed; the backend model snapshot is not pinned or independently identified.
The holdout consists of generated in-domain notices, not independently collected real notices.
A repeat over the same case set measures observed stability and adds no distinct holdout cases.

event.resampling_unit: whole event, retaining all its cases and repeated calls

confidence_intervals.limitation: Separate event and render-family cluster sensitivity intervals, not a multiway bootstrap; synthetic families cannot establish real-notice generalization.

render_family.resampling_unit: whole render family, retaining all its cases and paired calls

event_all_correct.definition: Every case and every repeat in the event is exactly correct
